page.layout: One page of manuscript, handwritten only; no printed text. Handwritten title lines at the top, a handwritten list of numbered notes below them, and blank paper beneath.
page.notes: The page carries handwriting only, in cursive pen, and no printed text. Under the rules, handwriting is left out. The handwritten title (roughly: "Historia Iesuitica", "De origine, regulis, constitutionibus, privilegiis ... ordinis Iesuitarum", dated "Tigvri 1619") and the numbered list of references below it (1) to 3), naming Vita S. Ignatii Loiolae, Venice 1622; P. Petri Maffei, Cologne 1589; and P. Ribadeneira, Antwerp 1590) are not transcribed. The handwriting is hard to read in places, so the wording given here is approximate.
